messages:
alex: FYI — we're getting a high-touch ask from a mobile partner: they want a cheaper embed price tier + an on-demand burst add-on for peak weekends. Need product call on scope and launch criteria by EOD Fri.
maria: Can you paste the partner's numbers? rough ARR / peak qps? that will drive whether we recommend a price break or commit discount.
sam: partner says ~$450k ARR if we can get embed price down ~40% and offer burst pool 2x baseline for weekends. otherwise they'll shop competitors.
katie: 40% is big. alternatives: 1) deep commit (12mo) with lower embed rate, 2) burst add-on priced for pay-as-you-go, or 3) hybrid (commit + capped burst credits).
leo: From infra POV burst pool needs autoscale + isolated queue for fairshare. Ops estimates ~3 sprint effort to add guarding + billing metering.
olivia: Sales asked for short-term workaround: give one-time promo credits for first 3 months while we productize. low risk, but messy for precedent.
alex: Key constraints for me: a) must preserve PLG simplicity (not +10 addons), b) sales needs an enterprise story for >$250k ARR deals, c) we need telemetry to measure churn/latency impact before GA.
maria: Launch criteria proposal:
- legal/compliance OK on pricing language
- telemetry: per-customer token and latency breakdown implemented
- billing: burst metering + invoiceable SKU
- ops: canary w/ automated fallback if latency > 200ms p50
- docs + sales playbook
sam: technical checklist looks ok. add: quota guardrails + circuit-breaker config (default conservative). we should avoid infinite burst.
katie: Pricing options (sketch):
```text
A) Commit 12mo: embeds $0.0006/unit (40% off), requires min $300k commit
B) Burst add-on: $X/hour pool (on top of base), metered, 10% premium
C) Promo: 3mo credits then standard pricing
``` 
we need finance input on margin impact.
leo: Ops preference = B with caps. Implementation: isolated redis queues, token counters per-customer, and sliding window rate limiter. estimate cost delta for worst-case weekend = +18% infra.
olivia: Sales note: customers care about contract length. If we push for 12mo commit we'll lose some prospects. Promo helps short-term conversions.
alex: Tradeoffs: Commit reduces revenue variability but increases sales friction. Burst keeps PLG simplicity but requires infra work and careful docs. Decision needed: do we pilot burst-only, commit-only, or hybrid for partner?
maria: My recommendation = pilot hybrid: offer 6mo commit (lower discount) + optional burst credits. Pilot to one partner, collect telemetry for 8 weeks, then decide GA.
katie: If we do hybrid, proposed terms: 6mo min, 25% embed discount, burst credits sold in increments with soft caps and auto-throttle. Sales gets rebate clause if usage exceeds forecast.
sam: agree on pilot. action items:
- alex: sign-off terms with partner (PO/forecast)
- maria: spec billing SKU + telemetry hooks
- leo: scope ops work + timeline (ETA 3 sprints)
- katie: draft contract language for 6mo pilot
- olivia: onboarding plan + sales playbook
- deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for pricing changes at 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC (reaction :rocket:)

alex: Great. I'll run terms by finance and confirm with partner. We'll reconvene Tue morning if anything changes. (reaction :thumbsup:)
